segments.name: High-purity process systems
segments.description: Designs, installs and maintains high-purity gas and chemical process systems and factory monitoring and control systems for semiconductor and electronics manufacturers.
segments.evidence: The Company determined it operates as one consolidated segment and therefore has one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Industrial clients, mainly semiconductor and electronics manufacturers, pay for customized high-purity process systems, facility monitoring and control systems, installation and value-added services.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer the overall solution design, installation and value-added services such as ancillary engineering, testing, plant hosting, calibration and maintenance.
